items.prompt: Immediately before processing index j, what must seen[x] count?

options.text: Occurrences of x at indexes strictly less than j.
options.why: The prefix boundary excludes both the current position and all future positions.

options.text: All occurrences of x anywhere in the full input.
options.why: That would count future partners and break the later-endpoint proof.

options.text: Only whether x appears, represented as 0 or 1.
options.why: Boolean membership loses multiplicity needed for distinct position pairs.

options.text: Occurrences of x strictly after j.
options.why: That is the opposite of the implemented forward-prefix invariant.

items.explanation: The prefix boundary excludes both the current position and all future positions.
